source.title: WPBSA Official Rules of the Games of Snooker and English Billiards
source.publisher: World Professional Billiards and Snooker Association
source.edition: Revised September 2024 (the 011/012 pinned edition; GH-382 completion)

miss_rule.cite: WPBSA Sec3 R14 (Foul and a Miss: strict-liability best-attempt model with the R14(a)(i) points-needed exemption, the R14(b) replace options as decision 17, the R14(d) sequence/Warning/frame-award ladder — model documented in rulesets/snooker_v2.rs)

free_ball.cite: WPBSA Sec2 R13; Sec3 R12 (free-ball nomination after a foul when snookered — Sec2 R17 geometry incl. the R17(a) in-hand D arm; R12(a)-(e) scoring/respot; R12(b)(ii) free-ball snooker foul; R12(f) voiding)

touching_ball.cite: WPBSA Sec3 R8 (touching-ball call at address, judged play-away: moving the called ball is the Sec2 R19 push stroke per R8(b)/R11(b)(v); clean play-away from a ball on or declared ball is the R8(c) no-penalty deemed contact)

replace_geometry.cite: WPBSA Sec3 R14(b) (all balls shall be replaced: the adapter restores the recorded pre-stroke placements byte-for-byte from the very scenario bytes it fed the kernel — replay-grade by construction)

free_ball_call.cite: WPBSA Sec3 R12 via Sec2 R17 (the referee's FREE BALL call: the crate's address_facts_json geometry over the adapter's live post-respot positions, recorded on the stroke's nomination wire)

not_modeled.cite: WPBSA Sec3 R10(i), R14(e), R14(f), R15, R16
not_modeled.reason: fouls committed without a stroke and consultation-period procedure have no judged events in a ShotRecord (the v1 boundary, unchanged)

'hit simultaneously with a ball on' is not mechanically distinguishable: kernel contacts at identical t resolve by emission order (the frozen P1 stream-position doctrine), so the first stream contact governs
out-of-stroke referee dialogue and repositioning; the declaration chip surfaces the called set instead
